title: fix: point the built-in agent MCP server at /mcp
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
Managed agents with Pollinations tools enabled fail: the runtime POSTs to `https://mcp.pollinations.ai`, which 404s.

Probed directly:
```
POST https://mcp.pollinations.ai      -> 404
GET  https://mcp.pollinations.ai      -> 200 {"transport":"streamable-http","endpoint":"/mcp"}
POST https://mcp.pollinations.ai/mcp  -> 401 "Send a Pollinations API key as a bearer token"
```
`apps/mcp/worker.js` routes only `/mcp` and returns 404 for every other pathname — its own discovery doc at `/` says so.

- `agent-runtime.ts:19` — append `/mcp` to the built-in server URL (used verbatim by `prompt-agent-runtime.ts:172`).
- `prompt-agent-fields.tsx:103` — the UI displayed the same bare URL to users next to the "Built-in" toggle.
- Adds a test asserting the constant. The existing runtime tests inject `https://mcp.pollinations.test/` and match on whatever they were given, so nothing covered the real value. Reverting the constant now fails the guard.

Introduced by #12336 (merged 20:36Z), reached production via #13426 (20:40Z).

Checks: `npx vitest run test/prompt-agent-runtime.test.ts` — 20 passed.

gist.headline: The agent found the door
gist.blurb: Managed agents were knocking on the MCP server's front porch instead of its actual door. The built-in tools now head straight to `/mcp`, where the useful machinery lives.
gist.summary: Fixed managed agents with Pollinations tools so the built-in MCP server URL uses `https://mcp.pollinations.ai/mcp` instead of the bare host, which only serves discovery information.
gist.impact: Agents with the Built-in tools toggle enabled can now reach the authenticated MCP endpoint and use Pollinations tools instead of receiving a 404.
